run_saliency_detection_on_image: run unsupervised saliency detection on a single image using --img-path with DINO ViT backbone
run_saliency_detection_on_dataset: run saliency detection on ECSSD, DUTS, or DUT dataset and evaluate against ground truth masks
run_tokencut_with_bilateral_solver: run TokenCut normalized cut followed by bilateral solver refinement for saliency map generation
get_tokencut_binary_map: get a binary bipartition mask and eigenvector from an image using DINO features and normalized cut
mask_color_compose: compose a colored mask overlay on an RGB image for saliency visualization output
